name: Fun'ya no Asayasu
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 37); Porter’s note gives the dates as: late 9th century.

poems.title: This lovely morn the dewdrops flash
poems.author: Fun'ya no Asayasu
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 37
poems.text:
This lovely morn the dewdrops flash
Like diamonds on the grass—
A blaze of sparkling jewels! But
The autumn wind, alas!
Scatters them as I pass.
